info.complementary_products: Choose up to 3 products manually. Leave empty to use Shopify's automatic complementary product recommendations.
info.frequently_bought_together_button_text: Leave blank to use the default "Add to cart" label.
info.frequently_bought_together_product: Which product this widget is about. Defaults to the current product when added on a product page — required when added elsewhere (e.g. a custom page).
info.enable_frequently_bought_together: Turn off to temporarily hide this block without losing your configuration.
